column1: #desc;Pisces is a constellation of the zodiac. Its vast bulk — and main asterism viewed in most European cultures per Greco-Roman antiquity as a distant pair of fishes connected by one cord each that join at an apex — are in the Northern celestial hemisphere. Its traditional astrological symbol is (♓︎). Its name is Latin for "fishes". It is between Aquarius
column5: to the east. The ecliptic and the celestial equator intersect within this constellation
column6: at the first point of Aries
column8: at the first point of Libra. The Sun passes directly overhead of the equator
column10: at approximately this point in the sky
